description: V1 under pressure. A stakeholder who describes everything in adjectives and never says a number, against a model scripted to invent one on every performance requirement. Measures validator interception rate: every fabricated candidate must be rejected pre-commit, so the fabricated-goal rate stays at zero. Also shows the real cost of a fabrication - the requirement is rejected with its invented number and has to be re-elicited from the human.

purpose_record.rationale: Prints fail and nobody notices until the end.

purpose_answer: I want the twin to keep a close eye on the printers and let us know quickly when something is going wrong.

maturity.reasoning: Detecting a fault during a job needs the twin to model behaviour.
maturity.description: The twin will watch each job, show you what the machine is doing, and work out when the extrusion has gone wrong. It will not predict failures in advance and it will not change your settings.
